svg.title: Let Ωa be the Euclidean skew generator in the time–spatial-a plane, with vector field xa∂t −t∂a. Write La for its action on a finite field space, and put Ka = −iLa for the corresponding Lorentz boost generator on labels. Differentiating Euclidean covariance at a configuration of distinct points gives D(ΩaXi)iSv(X) = − X i Sv[i←Lavi](X). (BC1)
